instructions.name: create_amm_config
instructions.title: Create AMM config (fee tier)
instructions.rationale: Creates a new fee-tier config; only the hardcoded Raydium admin key can sign.
instructions.notes: Wire data (50 bytes): [disc8 8934edd4d7756c68][index u16le @8][trade_fee_rate u64le @10][protocol_fee_rate u64le @18][fund_fee_rate u64le @26][create_pool_fee u64le @34][creator_fee_rate u64le @42]. Signer owner must equal crate::admin::ID (mainnet GThUX1Atko4tqhN2NaiTazWSeFWMuiUvfFnyJyUghFMJ, devnet DRayqG9RXYi8WHgWEmRQGrUWRWbhjYWYkCRJDd6JBBak). Rates are over FEE_RATE_DENOMINATOR_VALUE = 1_000_000 and create_pool_fee is in lamports, so none of these is a token amount. The new config's protocol_owner and fund_owner are written from the hardcoded protocol_fee_owner (mainnet ProCXqRcXJjoUd1RNoo28bSizAA6EEqt9wURZYPDc5u) and fund_fee_owner (mainnet FUNDduJTA7XcckKHKfAoEnnhuSud2JUCUZv6opWEjrBU) constants, not from the signer.

instructions.name: update_amm_config
instructions.title: Update AMM config
instructions.rationale: Rewrites a fee-tier config (fee rates, protocol/fund owner, create-pool fee, creation switch); only the hardcoded Raydium admin key can sign.
instructions.notes: Wire data (17 bytes): [disc8 313cae889a1c74c8][param u8 @8][value u64le @9]. Signer owner must equal crate::admin::ID (mainnet GThUX1Atko4tqhN2NaiTazWSeFWMuiUvfFnyJyUghFMJ, devnet DRayqG9RXYi8WHgWEmRQGrUWRWbhjYWYkCRJDd6JBBak); the doc comment says owner or admin but the constraint is admin-only. param selects the field: 0 trade_fee_rate, 1 protocol_fee_rate, 2 fund_fee_rate, 3 protocol_owner (new key is remaining_accounts[0]; value ignored), 4 fund_owner (same), 5 create_pool_fee (lamports), 6 disable_create_pool (0 = false, else true), 7 creator_fee_rate, 8 creator_fee_share_rate; any other param fails InvalidInput. Params 3 and 4 hand fee-collection rights to another key. value is a rate or flag, not a token amount.

instructions.name: update_pool_status
instructions.title: Update pool status
instructions.rationale: Overwrites a pool's status bitmask, pausing or resuming deposit, withdraw and swap; only the hardcoded Raydium admin key can sign.
instructions.notes: Wire data (9 bytes): [disc8 82576c062ee0757b][status u8 @8]. Signer authority must equal crate::admin::ID (mainnet GThUX1Atko4tqhN2NaiTazWSeFWMuiUvfFnyJyUghFMJ, devnet DRayqG9RXYi8WHgWEmRQGrUWRWbhjYWYkCRJDd6JBBak). status is the whole status byte, overwritten: bit0 set = deposit disabled, bit1 set = withdraw disabled, bit2 set = swap disabled (PoolStatusBitIndex, get_status_by_bit). A set bit makes the matching instruction fail with NotApproved.

instructions.name: collect_protocol_fee
instructions.title: Collect protocol fee
instructions.rationale: Sweeps accrued protocol fees from pool vaults to caller-chosen token accounts; signer must be the config's protocol owner or the Raydium admin.
instructions.notes: Wire data (24 bytes): [disc8 8888fcddc2427e59][amount_0_requested u64le @8][amount_1_requested u64le @16]. Account indices are 0-based. Signer owner must be amm_config.protocol_owner or crate::admin::ID (mainnet GThUX1Atko4tqhN2NaiTazWSeFWMuiUvfFnyJyUghFMJ, devnet DRayqG9RXYi8WHgWEmRQGrUWRWbhjYWYkCRJDd6JBBak). Each requested amount is clamped to the pool's accrued protocol fee, min(requested, accrued); a sampled mainnet call (slot 455229574, 2026-10-10) passed u64::MAX for both, so the arguments are not a usable spend bound. recipient_token_0_account (index 8) and recipient_token_1_account (index 9) have no owner constraint, so the signer picks the destination. The two amounts are independent and in different mints, so amount is null.

instructions.name: collect_fund_fee
instructions.title: Collect fund fee
instructions.rationale: Sweeps accrued fund fees from pool vaults to caller-chosen token accounts; signer must be the config's fund owner or the Raydium admin.
instructions.notes: Wire data (24 bytes): [disc8 a78a4e95dfc2067e][amount_0_requested u64le @8][amount_1_requested u64le @16]. Account indices are 0-based. Same shape as collect_protocol_fee but gated on amm_config.fund_owner (or crate::admin::ID (mainnet GThUX1Atko4tqhN2NaiTazWSeFWMuiUvfFnyJyUghFMJ, devnet DRayqG9RXYi8WHgWEmRQGrUWRWbhjYWYkCRJDd6JBBak)) and draining the fund_fees_token_0/1 counters. Each requested amount is clamped to the accrued fund fee. recipient_token_0_account (index 8) and recipient_token_1_account (index 9) have no owner constraint. The two amounts are independent and in different mints, so amount is null.

instructions.name: collect_creator_fee
instructions.title: Collect creator fee
instructions.rationale: Pool creator claims accrued creator fees (net of the protocol share) into the creator's own ATAs; destination is fixed, creator pays any ATA rent.
instructions.notes: Wire data is the 8-byte discriminator only (8 bytes). Account indices are 0-based. Signer creator must equal pool_state.pool_creator. Payout amounts are computed on-chain from the accrued creator fees minus the protocol's share (CreatorFeeShare PDA if present, else amm_config.creator_fee_share_rate). creator_token_0 (index 8) and creator_token_1 (index 9) are the creator's own associated token accounts (init_if_needed, creator pays rent), so the destination cannot be redirected. The creator_fee_share account (index 14) must be passed even when it does not exist. No amount argument.

instructions.name: collect_creator_fee_permissionless
instructions.title: Collect creator fee (permissionless)
instructions.rationale: Anyone can trigger; fees go to the pool creator's ATAs and the signer pays missing-ATA rent, so it benefits a third party.
instructions.notes: Wire data is the 8-byte discriminator only (8 bytes). Account indices are 0-based. Any payer (index 0) may sign. The creator account (index 1) is constrained to pool_state.pool_creator and creator_token_0 (index 8) / creator_token_1 (index 9) are the creator's associated token accounts (init_if_needed, payer funds the rent), so the payer cannot redirect fees but does donate ATA rent to a third party. Classified other with defaultDeny=true because it is a keeper-style call that benefits someone else, not an owner-fund outflow beyond rent; relax locally if an agent legitimately runs it. amm_config (index 14) and creator_fee_share (index 15) must be passed. No amount argument.

instructions.name: create_permission_pda
instructions.title: Create permission PDA
instructions.rationale: Grants a wallet the right to call initialize_with_permission by creating its Permission PDA; signer must be the Raydium admin or the dedicated grant owner.
instructions.notes: Wire data is the 8-byte discriminator only (8 bytes). Signer owner must be crate::admin::ID (mainnet GThUX1Atko4tqhN2NaiTazWSeFWMuiUvfFnyJyUghFMJ, devnet DRayqG9RXYi8WHgWEmRQGrUWRWbhjYWYkCRJDd6JBBak) or the dedicated create_permission_pda_owner (mainnet RayqjDRsNEFuPcDE4JpEScwJvwusmHYuNZ3MgET4D7U, devnet DRayJkSKsijbcEqdooK4uUGcT6gjbEuwUh7V6Nmqct7M). Creates the Permission PDA seeded ["permission", permission_authority]; the signer pays its rent. Holding that PDA is what lets permission_authority call initialize_with_permission. No arguments.

instructions.name: close_permission_pda
instructions.title: Close permission PDA
instructions.rationale: Revokes a wallet's permissioned pool-creation grant by closing its Permission PDA; rent goes to the signer (admin or dedicated grant owner).
instructions.notes: Wire data is the 8-byte discriminator only (8 bytes). Signer owner must be crate::admin::ID (mainnet GThUX1Atko4tqhN2NaiTazWSeFWMuiUvfFnyJyUghFMJ, devnet DRayqG9RXYi8WHgWEmRQGrUWRWbhjYWYkCRJDd6JBBak) or the dedicated create_permission_pda_owner (mainnet RayqjDRsNEFuPcDE4JpEScwJvwusmHYuNZ3MgET4D7U, devnet DRayJkSKsijbcEqdooK4uUGcT6gjbEuwUh7V6Nmqct7M); the dedicated owner was added to this instruction in the Sept 2026 upgrade (it was admin-only before). Closes the Permission PDA seeded ["permission", permission_authority] and sends its rent to the signer. No arguments.

instructions.name: create_creator_fee_share
instructions.title: Create creator fee share
instructions.rationale: Sets a custom protocol share of the creator fee for one (creator, amm_config) pair; admin or dedicated owner only.
instructions.notes: Wire data (16 bytes): [disc8 7f1fbc77abec8024][share_rate u64le @8]. Signer owner must be crate::admin::ID (mainnet GThUX1Atko4tqhN2NaiTazWSeFWMuiUvfFnyJyUghFMJ, devnet DRayqG9RXYi8WHgWEmRQGrUWRWbhjYWYkCRJDd6JBBak) or the dedicated create_creator_fee_share_owner (mainnet RayFfEhJHWToYRsr8sjVZZkdddBeYxyJazDitpdE7zJ, devnet DRayDe7AGe6nFg6egr7D42ECyDf15GV52WFwZAbfUo1R). share_rate is the protocol's share of the creator fee over 1_000_000 and must be <= 1_000_000 (else InvalidInput); it is a rate, not a token amount. Creates the CreatorFeeShare PDA seeded ["creator_fee_share", creator, amm_config]; the pool creator does not sign. There is no update path: close and re-create to change a rate.

instructions.name: close_creator_fee_share
instructions.title: Close creator fee share
instructions.rationale: Closes a creator-fee-share override so the pair falls back to the config default rate; rent goes to the signer; admin or dedicated owner only.
instructions.notes: Wire data is the 8-byte discriminator only (8 bytes). Signer owner must be crate::admin::ID (mainnet GThUX1Atko4tqhN2NaiTazWSeFWMuiUvfFnyJyUghFMJ, devnet DRayqG9RXYi8WHgWEmRQGrUWRWbhjYWYkCRJDd6JBBak) or the dedicated create_creator_fee_share_owner (mainnet RayFfEhJHWToYRsr8sjVZZkdddBeYxyJazDitpdE7zJ, devnet DRayDe7AGe6nFg6egr7D42ECyDf15GV52WFwZAbfUo1R). Closes the CreatorFeeShare PDA for (creator, amm_config) and sends its rent to the signer; later collections use amm_config.creator_fee_share_rate. No arguments.

instructions.name: initialize
instructions.title: Initialize pool
instructions.rationale: Creates a pool and seeds it with the creator's two tokens, pays the create-pool fee and rent, and mints LP tokens to the creator.
instructions.notes: Wire data (32 bytes): [disc8 afaf6d1f0d989bed][init_amount_0 u64le @8][init_amount_1 u64le @16][open_time u64le @24]. Account indices are 0-based. Signer creator (index 0) pays for everything and receives the LP tokens. init_amount_0 and init_amount_1 move from creator_token_0 (index 7) and creator_token_1 (index 8), which must be owned by the signer, into new pool vaults; the ratio of the two amounts sets the pool's starting price. Also charges amm_config.create_pool_fee lamports (system transfer to the create_pool_fee receiver DNXgeM9EiiaAbaWvwjHj9fQQLAX5ZsfHyvmYUNRAdNC8 on mainnet, 3oE58BKVt8KuYkGxx8zBojugnymWmBiyafWgMrnb6eYy on devnet) plus rent for the new accounts. open_time is a unix timestamp; a value <= now is bumped to now + 1. LP mint decimals = 9. The two amounts are independent and in different mints, so amount is null: a limit on one does not bound the other.

instructions.name: initialize_with_permission
instructions.title: Initialize pool (with permission)
instructions.rationale: Permissioned pool creation: seeds a new pool from the payer's two tokens and lets the payer name the creator that earns creator fees.
instructions.notes: Wire data (33 bytes): [disc8 3f37fe4131b25979][init_amount_0 u64le @8][init_amount_1 u64le @16][open_time u64le @24][creator_fee_on u8 enum CreatorFeeOn @32]. Account indices are 0-based. Signer payer (index 0) funds the pool and must hold a Permission PDA seeded ["permission", payer] (index 15, created by create_permission_pda); without it the call fails. The creator account (index 1) is a caller-chosen, non-signing address stored as pool_creator, so the payer can direct future creator fees elsewhere. init_amount_0 and init_amount_1 move from payer_token_0 (index 8) and payer_token_1 (index 9), which must be owned by the payer; create_pool_fee lamports and rent are also charged. creator_fee_on is the unit-variant Borsh enum CreatorFeeOn as one byte: 0 BothToken, 1 OnlyToken0, 2 OnlyToken1. enable_creator_fee is forced true. The two amounts are independent and in different mints, so amount is null.

instructions.name: deposit
instructions.title: Deposit liquidity
instructions.rationale: Adds liquidity: pulls both tokens from owner-controlled accounts (capped by max amounts) into pool vaults and mints LP tokens to the owner.
instructions.notes: Wire data (32 bytes): [disc8 f223c68952e1f2b6][lp_token_amount u64le @8][maximum_token_0_amount u64le @16][maximum_token_1_amount u64le @24]. Account indices are 0-based. Signer owner (index 0) must own owner_lp_token (3), token_0_account (4) and token_1_account (5); LP tokens are minted to owner_lp_token. amount is lp_token_amount, the LP tokens minted (LP mint decimals = 9), not a token spend. The owner's real outflow follows the pool ratio and is capped by maximum_token_0_amount (@16) and maximum_token_1_amount (@24), in the two pool mints' base units and including any Token-2022 transfer fee; a single amount cannot express both caps, so enforce them separately.

instructions.name: withdraw
instructions.title: Withdraw liquidity
instructions.rationale: Burns the owner's LP tokens and sends the pro-rata pool tokens to two receiving accounts the caller chooses, not tied to the owner.
instructions.notes: Wire data (32 bytes): [disc8 b712469c946da122][lp_token_amount u64le @8][minimum_token_0_amount u64le @16][minimum_token_1_amount u64le @24]. Account indices are 0-based. Signer owner (index 0) must own owner_lp_token (3), whose LP tokens are burned. token_0_account (4) and token_1_account (5) receive the pool tokens and are constrained only by mint, not by owner, so the signer picks the recipients; pin them in the mandate. amount is lp_token_amount, the LP tokens burned (LP mint decimals = 9). minimum_token_0_amount (@16) and minimum_token_1_amount (@24) are slippage floors on the net amounts received.

instructions.name: swap_base_input
instructions.title: Swap (exact input)
instructions.rationale: Swaps an exact input amount for the pool's output token; output goes to any token account supplied, and only minimum_amount_out guards price.
instructions.notes: Wire data (24 bytes): [disc8 8fbe5adac41e33de][amount_in u64le @8][minimum_amount_out u64le @16]. Account indices are 0-based. Signer payer (index 0) must control input_token_account (4). output_token_account (5) is constrained only to be a token account, with no owner constraint, so the signer picks who receives the proceeds; pin it in the mandate. amount_in (@8) is the gross debit in base units of the input mint (input_token_mint, index 10), including any Token-2022 transfer fee. minimum_amount_out (@16) is the floor on the net output; 0 is accepted and removes the floor. Layout confirmed on 96 real mainnet instructions sampled 2026-10-10 (all 24 bytes).

instructions.name: swap_base_output
instructions.title: Swap (exact output)
instructions.rationale: Swaps for an exact output amount paying up to max_amount_in; output goes to any token account supplied, and max_amount_in is the only price guard.
instructions.notes: Wire data (24 bytes): [disc8 37d96256a34ab4ad][max_amount_in u64le @8][amount_out u64le @16]. Account indices are 0-based. Signer payer (index 0) must control input_token_account (4). output_token_account (5) has no owner constraint, so the signer picks the recipient; pin it in the mandate. amount is max_amount_in (@8), a cap on the gross debit in base units of the input mint (input_token_mint, index 10, including any Token-2022 transfer fee); the actual debit is computed on-chain and is at most that cap, so using it as the spend over-counts rather than under-counts. amount_out (@16) is the exact net amount the output account receives. Same 24-byte shape as swap_base_input; confirmed on 1 real mainnet instruction sampled 2026-10-10.

instructions.name: create_support_mint_associated
instructions.title: Register support mint
instructions.rationale: Whitelists a Token-2022 mint past the extension allow-list by creating its SupportMintAssociated PDA; admin or dedicated owner only.
instructions.notes: Wire data is the 8-byte discriminator only (8 bytes). Signer owner must be crate::admin::ID (mainnet GThUX1Atko4tqhN2NaiTazWSeFWMuiUvfFnyJyUghFMJ, devnet DRayqG9RXYi8WHgWEmRQGrUWRWbhjYWYkCRJDd6JBBak) or the dedicated create_support_mint_associated_owner (mainnet Rayv2LG4tFSMizZhMP8aSUYxDPjV8qJtx2NQY9RKYZy, devnet DRaypyeDL6y1dUusMgwyeDM5JebjhsSi8aRXobKQ9DcQ). token_mint must be owned by Token-2022. Creates the SupportMintAssociated PDA seeded ["support_mint", token_mint], which lets that mint bypass the Token-2022 extension allow-list when a pool is created. No arguments.

instructions.name: close_support_mint_associated
instructions.title: Unregister support mint
instructions.rationale: Removes a mint's allow-list bypass by closing its SupportMintAssociated PDA; rent goes to the signer; admin or dedicated owner only.
instructions.notes: Wire data is the 8-byte discriminator only (8 bytes). Signer owner must be crate::admin::ID (mainnet GThUX1Atko4tqhN2NaiTazWSeFWMuiUvfFnyJyUghFMJ, devnet DRayqG9RXYi8WHgWEmRQGrUWRWbhjYWYkCRJDd6JBBak) or the dedicated create_support_mint_associated_owner (mainnet Rayv2LG4tFSMizZhMP8aSUYxDPjV8qJtx2NQY9RKYZy, devnet DRaypyeDL6y1dUusMgwyeDM5JebjhsSi8aRXobKQ9DcQ). Closes the SupportMintAssociated PDA seeded ["support_mint", token_mint] and sends its rent to the signer. Existing pools are unaffected because the mint check runs only at pool creation. No arguments.

instructions.name: collect_excess_lamports
instructions.title: Collect excess lamports
instructions.rationale: Sweeps lamports above the rent-exempt minimum from pool-controlled accounts into the signer's wallet; admin or dedicated wallet only.
instructions.notes: Wire data is the 8-byte discriminator only (8 bytes). Signer collect_lamports_wallet must be crate::admin::ID (mainnet GThUX1Atko4tqhN2NaiTazWSeFWMuiUvfFnyJyUghFMJ, devnet DRayqG9RXYi8WHgWEmRQGrUWRWbhjYWYkCRJDd6JBBak) or the dedicated collect_lamports wallet (mainnet RayGkhY93thaTgCv98sx1pNLgBHhJDxWUeZXp4bjmnp, devnet DRaydJNq54dSDHUqYCE3G8YySgaXfZucbh7dTXw9fBMs). No arguments: source accounts are passed as remaining accounts after the four fixed ones. For each source owned by Token or Token-2022 it CPIs the token program to move only the lamports above the account's rent-exempt minimum (wrapped SOL uses SyncNative then UnwrapLamports for the excess delta); for each CPMM-owned PDA it debits the excess directly; anything else is skipped. Every swept lamport goes to the signer.
